nodes.description: IXStore public state variable holding the protocol storage contract, used for vault metadata, holdings, eligibility and manager lookups.
Mapping vaultId => bool marking whether a vault holds ERC1155 assets; drives transfer path selection.
Mapping v1 vault id => v2 vault (token) address used by migrateV1Tokens to pay out v2 tokens.
Mapping vaultId => bool marking a v1 vault whose holdings are fully migrated to v2.
Ownable owner address; compared against msg.sender in onlyOwner/onlyPrivileged access control.
Pausable mapping pauserId => bool controlling whether mint/redeem/migrate operations are blocked for non-owners.
Owner-only migration of a v1 vault's holdings into a v2 vault via approveERC721 and INFTXVault mint.
Owner-only targeted redeem of specificIds from a v1 vault using _redeemHelper.
Owner-only direct withdrawal of specific NFT ids from a v1 vault to an arbitrary recipient.
Owner-only flag setting isFullyMigrated for a vault id.
Burns caller v1 xTokens and transfers the equivalent v2 tokens from migrationPair to msg.sender.
Internal helper that builds calldata for kitties/punks/default assets and performs a raw low-level call to assetAddr.
Public payable nonReentrant mint entry point; dispatches to _mintD2 or _mint.
Public payable nonReentrant redeem entry point; dispatches to _redeem or _redeemD2.
Internal mint loop: validates eligibility, pulls NFTs via transferFrom/safeTransferFrom and mints xTokens.
Internal random redeem loop that picks holdings using _getPseudoRand and calls _redeemHelper.
Internal helper that burns xTokens and transfers NFTs out of the vault to msg.sender.
Internal v2 (dual) redeem: burns xTokens from caller and transfers d2 assets back.
Internal v2 (dual) mint: pulls d2 asset from caller, mints xTokens and updates d2Holdings.
Weak pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp (now), msg.sender and store nonce modulo holdings length.
Public nonReentrant function returning requested NFTs to the requester.
Privileged function approving pending mint requests and minting xTokens to requesters.
Initializer setting the store address and running ownable/reentrancy initializers.
Internal access-control helper: requires msg.sender to be owner (finalized vault) or store manager.
Attacker-controllable caller address used throughout for auth checks, transfers and token minting.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (`now`) used as randomness entropy in _getPseudoRand.
Raw address(assetAddr).call(data) in approveERC721 to kitty/punk/ERC721 targets.
External IERC721/IERC1155 transferFrom/safeTransferFrom calls that can invoke receiver callbacks.
External IXToken mint/burnFrom calls on vault xTokens (mint/burn hooks).
External ERC20 transfer/safeTransfer of v2 token or d2 asset to msg.sender.
Parameter identifying the v1 vault being migrated, withdrawn or redeemed.
Parameter identifying the destination v2 vault id resolved through INFTXVaultFactory.
Parameter limiting how many holdings are migrated in migrateVaultToV2.
Array of NFT ids to redeem or withdraw in targetRedeem/targetWithdraw.
Recipient address for withdrawn NFTs in targetWithdraw.
Parameter identifying the vault in mint/redeem and vault config setters.
Array of NFT ids supplied to _mint, revokeMintRequests and approveMintRequest.
Amount of dual (v2) asset used in the D2 mint path.
Generic amount parameter for redeem and D2 redeem.
Local address of the asset contract resolved in migrateVaultToV2 and used by approveERC721.
Local address of the resolved v2 vault in migrateVaultToV2.
Local balance of v1 xTokens held by msg.sender in migrateV1Tokens.
Local pseudo-random index from _getPseudoRand used to select a holding in _redeem.

edges.reason: v1VaultId parameter drives the migration target vault and holdings lookups.
v2VaultId is passed to INFTXVaultFactory.vault() to resolve the destination vault.
count bounds the migration loop and is used in count * 10**18 arithmetic check.
v1VaultId selects the vault whose holdings are redeemed in targetRedeem.
specificIds are forwarded to _redeemHelper for targeted redemption.
v1VaultId selects the vault from which NFTs are withdrawn in targetWithdraw.
specificIds are iterated and checked against holdings in targetWithdraw.
to is the recipient address for the transferred NFTs.
v1VaultId is the key written to isFullyMigrated in forceMigrationComplete.
v1VaultId indexes store.xToken and migrationPair in migrateV1Tokens.
msg.sender balance is burned and receives the transferred v2 tokens in migrateV1Tokens.
vaultId selects the vault in the mint entry point.
nftIds array is iterated and transferred inside _mint.
d2Amount is multiplied by 1000 and used in d2Holdings arithmetic in _mintD2.
amount is multiplied by 1000 and subtracted from d2Holdings in _redeemD2.
nftIds are iterated and returned to the requester in revokeMintRequests.
nftIds are iterated and marked eligible in approveMintRequest.
msg.sender must equal store.requester to revoke a mint request.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of NFT transfers and the burner in _redeemHelper.
msg.sender is the source of NFT transfers and the recipient of minted xTokens in _mint.
msg.sender is compared to owner() or store.manager() in onlyPrivileged access control.
msg.sender supplies the d2 asset and receives xTokens in _mintD2.
msg.sender xTokens are burned and d2 asset is transferred to msg.sender in _redeemD2.
block.timestamp (now) is used as randomness entropy, making the result timestamp-dependent.
_owner is the trusted value compared against msg.sender in onlyPrivileged.
isPaused mapping gates the mint entry point through onlyOwnerIfPaused.
store provides holdings, addresses and flags consumed during migration.
store is queried for holdings, eligibility and NFT addresses in _redeemHelper.
store.randNonce is read and incremented to seed the pseudo-random value.
migrationPair resolves the v2 token that is transferred to the caller.
isFullyMigrated must be true before v1 tokens can be exchanged in migrateV1Tokens.
isVault1155 selects the ERC1155 vs ERC721 transfer path in _redeemHelper.
migrateVaultToV2 calls approveERC721 for each NFT before migrating.
targetRedeem delegates the actual burn/transfer work to _redeemHelper.
mint dispatches to the ERC721/ERC1155 mint path _mint.
mint dispatches to the dual-asset mint path _mintD2.
redeem dispatches to the random redeem path _redeem.
redeem dispatches to the dual-asset redeem path _redeemD2.
_redeem calls _redeemHelper for each randomly selected holding.
_redeem consumes the timestamp-seeded pseudo-random index returned by _getPseudoRand.
approveMintRequest invokes onlyPrivileged before approving requests.
_mint performs external NFT transferFrom/safeTransferFrom calls.
_redeemHelper performs external NFT safeTransferFrom calls to the caller.
targetWithdraw performs external NFT transfer/safeTransferFrom calls.
approveERC721 executes the raw low-level call to assetAddr.
migrateV1Tokens calls external xToken.balanceOf and burnFrom.
_redeemHelper calls external xToken.burnFrom on the vault token.
migrateV1Tokens transfers the v2 token to msg.sender.
ERC721/ERC1155 transferFrom callbacks can reenter _mint before holdings accounting completes.
safeTransferFrom in _redeemHelper triggers receiver callbacks enabling reentrant redeem.
NFT transfer callbacks can reenter revokeMintRequests during the loop.
targetWithdraw transfer callbacks can reenter the withdrawal loop.
Arbitrary low-level call to assetAddr can invoke attacker code that reenters approveERC721 caller.
External burnFrom on a malicious xToken can reenter _redeemHelper before NFT transfers finish.
assetAddr local is the asset argument passed into approveERC721.
assetAddr is the target address of the raw low-level call.
v2Vault local resolves the destination vault address used for minting.
bal is the caller balance burned and transferred in migrateV1Tokens.
rand (derived from block.timestamp) selects the holding to redeem in _redeem.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only meaningful as the vault id argument of migrateVaultToV2.
Parameter is used only to resolve the destination vault in migrateVaultToV2.
Loop bound and arithmetic input local to migrateVaultToV2.
Array parameter consumed by the targetWithdraw withdrawal loop.
Recipient parameter used only by targetWithdraw.
Vault identifier parameter used by the mint entry point.
NFT id array is iterated and transferred inside _mint.
Dual asset amount parameter consumed by _mintD2 arithmetic.
Amount parameter consumed by the _redeemD2 burn/transfer path.
Local asset address is resolved for and used by approveERC721.
Local resolved v2 vault address only exists within migrateVaultToV2.
Local caller xToken balance used only in migrateV1Tokens.
Local pseudo-random index only used by the _redeem selection loop.
